Serial, photo metadata and weight are consistent with a full delivery and inconsistent with the claim.

The agent bought one headphones line at EUR 249, inside the signed mandate (max EUR 280, one unit). Nothing was pre-selected by us and no listing instruction steered the agent. The buyer keeps the genuine set and demands EUR 249 without a return, on a photo that itself shows the case serial. That claim is contradicted. Outcome AG5, buyer liable. Delivered 7 Nov 2026, filed 15 Nov 2026: the only residual path is EU 14-day withdrawal, return at the buyer's cost, not an AG3 refund.
